scope: Historical candidate evidence custody; no hardware access or new measurement.

monocypher.result_sha256_semantics: Canonical parsed result, not raw serial capture.

monocypher.next_gate: Locate independently retained raw transcript or use a separately authorized successor capture.

mbedtls_corrected.capture_semantics: Validated canonical frame stream; not raw startup serial bytes.

limitations: Scoped lack of matching hashes does not establish global absence.
Receipt authenticity and historical aggregate measurements are distinct from replayable raw capture custody.
This assessment grants no hardware authority and closes neither Phase 3 nor library selection.
